members.name: open
members.description: The pinned AlertDialogAction is an ordinary Button, not a Close wrapper. Its onClick invokes the caller action and does not automatically close the alert dialog. AlertDialogCancel wraps the primitive Close. The caller explicitly closes after successful work when desired; cancellation never emits a destructive confirmation.
